nowFeed.linkText: Former Broncos' coaches Mike Shanahan and Dan Reeves were among the five coaches selected to be considered for the Hall of Fame Class of 2027. The list of five, released Thursday that also includes Bill Belichick, Tom Coughlin and Mike Holmgren, will be trimmed to one later this month. That one coach will then be among the 15 candidates, including players and a contributor nominee, who will be considered for the Hall's Class of '27.

Veteran defensive coach Paul Pasqualoni is set to join Florida State next week as an analyst to help the defensive staff, per ESPN sources. He’s the former head coach at Syracuse and UConn and a longtime NFL coordinator and assistant. Pasqualoni, 77, has been coaching as an assistant at Avon Old Farms. 

He’ll start with FSU next week after the Boston College game. Both his son and daughter are on the BC football staff. FSU is down two assistants on defense.

Broncos coach Sean Payton was asked Wednesday about the looking trade deadline:  
“I always think there’s buyers and sellers, right?’’ Payton said. “It’s probably more noticeable in the last five years than maybe, or at least I notice it more. Teams that are playing well are the potential buyers, the teams maybe that aren’t are the potential sellers.’’

Payton was then asked if the Broncos were buyers:
 “We’re a team that’s playing better, we’re not looking to sell,’’ Payton said.

nowFeed.linkText: Sunday's game against Carolina is one of just two the Broncos currently have this season with an 11 a.m. kickoff (Mountain time) -- their Dec. 13 game at the Jets is the other unless flexed later. The Broncos will travel Friday after practice and do their usual Saturday work in the Charlotte area. The Broncos are 3-1 in games in Payton's tenure in that early kickoff slot in the Eastern time zone. Asked Wednesday about it, Payton said: "We’re not going to Europe, we’re going to Charlotte.''
